  tf.transaction_hash,
  tf.log_index,
  tf.token_address,
  tf.recipient_address
FROM 
  nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.token_transfer_facts tf
WHERE 
  tf.start_date BETWEEN '2026-05-31' AND '2026-07-01'
  AND tf.end_date BETWEEN '2026-05-31' AND '2026-07-01'
  AND tf.mixer_service = 'TC'
ORDER BY 
  tf.transaction_hash DESC
LIMIT 
  20
